what: Whole test programs for this processor that report on a screen, run from reset on this processor with conformance/board.py standing in for everything around it, and read back off the text they print. What is kept here is what they printed, never the program.
why: Each program checks its own results and prints the verdict; nothing it tests lives outside the processor. The board gives it the memory map, work RAM, video memory read as text, the vblank flags it waits on and a pad that presses A and lets go, so a program that stops on a failure moves on to its next test.
